# Oasis CNST

> Oasis CNST (Clinical Nutrition Support Tool) is a free, offline-capable clinical nutrition web app for dietitians and nutrition students in Malawi. It provides evidence-based calculators, growth charts, and decision-support tools for adult and pediatric nutrition care.

Oasis CNST is a Progressive Web App — installable on Android, iOS, and desktop directly from the browser, no app store required. It works fully offline once installed and syncs data when back online.

## Core modules

- Adult nutrition: Schofield energy equations, malnutrition screening, GLIM assessment
- Pediatric nutrition: Fenton 2013 growth charts, WHO z-scores, pediatric burns calculator
- Parenteral & enteral nutrition (PN): TPN and enteral feed calculators
- Nutrition Screening: 5-tool screening suite (SCREEN tab)
- Drug-Nutrient Interaction (DNI) checker
- CMAM protocol support, per Malawi Ministry of Health 2016 guidelines
- Malawi Food Composition Table (FCT) meal planner and recipe calculator
- Library: clinical references and nutrition news feed

## Notes

- Built and maintained by Edison Taimu, a self-taught developer with a clinical dietetics background.
- Intended for dietitians, nutrition students, and clinicians working in low-resource settings.
- Not a substitute for professional clinical judgment; calculators support, not replace, clinical decision-making.
